cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - DrillBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
A parametrized box for drills
![Multiple DrillBoxes](static/samples/DrillBoxes.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes DrillBox --sx '30*2' --sy '50*3' --sh 8:20:20:12 --bottom_edge s --top_edge S --holes 2 --firsthole 2.0 --holeincrement 1.0 --thickness 5 --burn 0.2 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes DrillBox --sx --sy --sh --bottom_edge --top_edge --holes --firsthole --holeincrement --thickness --burn --reference --labels
